item.title: MSME launches credit outreach campaign
item.description: Visakhapatnam: As part of its continued efforts to support and empower the MSME sector, the Central Bank of India, regional office in Visakhapatnam organised an MSME credit outreach campaign in Visakhapatnam.Chanchal Kumar, DFO, MSME, who attended as chief guest, highlighted the importance of accessible credit for the growth of micro, small and medium enterprises. During the programme, customers were briefed about the bank’s attractive MSME loan schemes, digital services and various initiatives
